analysis.title: GS Duttenhoefer - Duttenhoefer's Daily 22.10.2026
key_insights: S&P 500 rose 58bps to 7757 (+13.3% YTD) on low volumes. US 10yr unchanged at 5.09%, Brent $111 with no Iran progress, Gold $4091, Bitcoin $83k.

Earnings in focus post-market: Meta +2%, Tesla -3%, Lam -7%, IBM -5%. Kospi fell 4% on Samsung -5% and SK Hynix -6%, with no AI-trade relief delivered yet. Attention turns to other hyperscaler earnings next week.

Meta 3Q revenue was $64.6bn (+26% y/y) vs consensus $63.5bn. Q4'26 revenue guide is $73.0-76.0bn vs consensus $73.60bn. FY2026 capex guide is $135-145bn vs prior $130-145bn. GS raises its price target to $885 from $860 and maintains a positive view.

Meta says Muse is emerging as a leading consumer agentic platform and monetization may come earlier than past products. Shopping with Muse is used by more than 25% of Muse WAUs, with average purchases of $200+. Management flagged compute capacity as a limiting factor over the next year and expects more than tenfold compute cost-efficiency improvement.

Tesla 3Q showed autonomy progress (FSD on over 75% of new US deliveries), strong backlog and better gross margins. Higher opex, lower Energy segment revenue and Optimus uncertainty weighed on the shares. GS lowers 2026/27 EPS on opex, raises 2028 on gross margin, and keeps its $360 price target.

SpaceX rose 8% on management's comment that new compute at current pricing pays back in under one year, possibly about 6 months in 2027. GS raised CY27 revenue estimates by 50% overnight, after a 55% raise in early August.
An a16z letter says inference demand is growing fast: token demand rises 24x from 2026 to 2030 while available power rises about 2x, so physical infrastructure stays scarce.
OpenAI acquired Orchestra Bio, which builds AI agents for drug-discovery operations at biotech companies.

PHP vulnerabilities were found by researchers using advanced AI code-analysis tools. Governments and cyber agencies are working to contain the fallout. GS points to its 16-stock Cyber basket (GSTMTCYB Index).
GS likes buying the Power Up America basket (GSENEPOW), calling power the most underappreciated AI bottleneck, with low positioning, normalized valuation and intact fundamentals.

About 75% of the US inflation surprise is attributed to mismeasurement or one-time factors expected to fade. GS sees no strong evidence of underlying acceleration and forecasts core PCE falling to 2.2% by Dec27, raising the question of Fed cuts in 2027.
Hedge funds heavily net sold global equities in October, with short sales outpacing long buys about 5 to 1. Short leverage is approaching 5-year highs, at the 99th percentile.

GS moves back to Overweight equities on a 3-month view (in line with 12 months), citing supportive earnings growth and improved asymmetry after the valuation de-rating. It also moves to Overweight bonds for 12 months as inflation normalises and central bank pricing becomes less hawkish.
NDX forward P/E is 20.5x, the lowest since the AI cycle began in 2023, and only about a 1.8x premium to the S&P 500, the narrowest in nearly 10 years.
